title: Pray for the dead: Bishop Strickland on Purgatory and the holy souls
description: Bringing you the news from a traditional Catholic perspective. During the month of November, after All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day, Bishop Joseph Strickland urges Catholics to pray for the faithful departed. Drawing on Church teaching, he explains that purgatory is the final purification of those who die in God’s grace and friendship but still need to be made completely holy before entering the full communion of heaven. These “holy souls” are assured of salvation. title: Leo’s Vatican forbids bishops from insisting on ad orientem Mass
description: Bringing you the news from a traditional Catholic perspective. The Vatican intervened in the Syro-Malabar Catholic Church in India, with the Apostolic Signatura reportedly siding with priests who wanted to celebrate Mass facing the congregation rather than ad orientem despite their bishops’ direction. John-Henry Westen argues the decision raises questions about the Vatican’s treatment of traditional liturgical practices beyond the Latin Mass.
